    BLOG

         Hi! I’m Tyler and I’m 21. I live in Liverpool and I’m a hairdresser. I had an awful night, last
         night. On my way home from work, I had an accident. I fell off my motorbike in the middle
         of the road. Luckily, a car didn’t hit me, but my motorbike went flying across the road and
       crashed into a tree. I hit my arm badly and it hurt a lot. So, I called my sister, and she drove
     me to hospital. And guess what? I broke my arm and now it’s in plaster! It’s horrible! But
         that’s not all. I can go to work but I can’t play football for two months. What a nightmare!

          posted by Jim Bevan        13:46pm



     1. Jim had an accident at work.
     2. Jim crashed his car into a tree.
     3. Jim’s sister took him to hospital.
     4. Jim broke his arm and can’t go to work.                                 SCORE     8
